quotes.quote: WebDev Arena allows users to test LLMs in a real-world coding task: building interactive web applications.
Users submit a prompt, two LLMs generate web apps, and the community votes on which model performs better.
Similar to Chatbot Arena , we use the Bradley-Terry (BT) model, which estimates model strengths from pairwise comparisons.
